title: About Me
text:
Hello! I’m Rohan Singh Rajput, a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Capital One based in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. I specialize in building scalable ML systems and have a passion for leveraging data science and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems.


With over 8 years of experience in machine learning, data science, and software engineering, I focus on:

Machine Learning Engineering: Developing production-ready ML systems and scalable solutions
Recommender Systems: Designing and optimizing recommendation algorithms
Deep Learning: Working with neural networks, RNNs, LSTMs, and modern frameworks like TensorFlow
Data Science: Analyzing large-scale datasets and extracting actionable insights
Cloud Computing: Experience with AWS, distributed computing, and HPC environments





Master’s in Computer Science - University of Central Florida
Machine Learning - Stanford University (Coursera)
Data Science Certifications - DataCamp, Coursera
GRE: Quantitative 151, Verbal 151





Solar Power Forecasting: Built deep learning models using RNN-LSTM for temporal-spatial energy forecasting
HPC ML Implementation: Large-scale machine learning on supercomputers and GPU clusters
Patent: “System and Method for Scaling Content Across Multiple Form Factors” (US10825134B2)
Hackathon Winner: Royal Bank of Canada & Microsoft Hackathon (2017)
Research Publications: Presented at international conferences on electrical engineering




Programming Languages: Python, R, Java, MATLAB, JavaScript
ML Frameworks: TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Scikit-learn
Data Tools: Pandas, NumPy, Apache Spark, Hadoop
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure
Databases: SQL, NoSQL



I regularly write about machine learning, recommender systems, and data science topics. My articles have been featured on LinkedIn and I’ve spoken at conferences like RecSys 2022.




LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rohan3
Location: Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex

This blog is built using Quarto, a powerful publishing system that allows me to write in Markdown and generate beautiful websites. Here, I share my thoughts on technology, programming, machine learning, and various topics that interest me.
Feel free to explore the posts and get in touch!
